subject: Request for Pollination Contract Details
body_text:
Hi there, 

I hope this message finds you well! I’m reaching out to finalize our pollination needs for this season. We’d like to order 30 hives for our orchard block, targeting the blueberry bloom in early April. If possible, we would prefer a split delivery, with 15 hives arriving in the first week of April and the remaining 15 the following week. 

Could you please send over a clear contract reflecting these details? We’re looking to keep everything consistent with last year’s arrangement. Thanks in advance for your help!

Best,  
David Ramirez  
Mountain Valley Farms

subject: Request for Pollination Services and Hive Management
body_text:
Hi there,

I hope this message finds you well! I'm reaching out on behalf of Cascade Orchard Partners as we begin planning our pollination needs for the upcoming season. We have multiple sites across the Willamette Valley and will need hives for our cherry, apple, and pear crops.

For our cherry orchard located in Salem, we would require approximately 60 hives starting from late March to mid-April. The apple trees in our Corvallis orchard will need around 75 hives for a similar duration, and we’d like 50 hives for our pear trees in Junction City from early April into May. 

Could you provide details on availability, any necessary contract adjustments, and potential scheduling conflicts? Additionally, we’re interested in exploring your bee products for our local distribution. 

Thanks for your help, and I look forward to your prompt response!

Best,  
Carlos Roberts
